channel.title: ThisWeek Desktop Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the current ThisWeek desktop app.

item.description:
ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.12

Fixes a bug where typing quickly in My Note could revert the editor to an older version and lose recent edits.

  • Background refreshes no longer overwrite newer local note content with a stale server snapshot.
  • The editor keeps your in-progress typing while a save or sync is in flight.
  • Pending autosaves flush when you switch notes, so the last keystrokes aren’t dropped.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.11

Open notes and Enhanced summaries instantly from local cache, then sync in the background.

  • Workspaces, spaces, notes, and folders paint from local storage first.
  • Enhanced summaries show cached content immediately, then refresh online.
  • Server sync still updates everything when you’re connected.

ThisWeek Desktop 0.1.10

See offline sync progress while notes download to this Mac.

  • Live “Syncing 42/180” indicator in the header while prefetch runs.
  • Settings → General shows a progress bar for notes, summaries, and audio.
  • Sync now button to refresh the offline pack on demand.
